basis: Observed full desktop, portrait and landscape Discovery A→B→A recordings, telemetry and safety samples; targets are capture cues, not product semantics.

milestones.label: M01
milestones.observedChange: The developed sheet fades behind the floor and the room contents gain depth while the footprint remains fixed.

milestones.label: M02
milestones.observedChange: The west sideboard wall rotates upward around its floor edge with attached joinery.

milestones.label: M03
milestones.observedChange: The kitchen wall rises around the same floor edge; the cabinets and tile remain associated with it.

milestones.label: M04
milestones.observedChange: The window wall and its seat rotate into the room boundary without losing the opening.

milestones.label: M05
milestones.observedChange: The door wall rises, preserving the same opening and floor geometry.

milestones.label: M06
milestones.observedChange: The ceiling pivots down over the four erected walls, enclosing the kitchen.

milestones.label: M07
milestones.observedChange: All six authored surfaces read as one closed room; sheet and introductory copy have faded.

milestones.label: M08
milestones.observedChange: The camera changes from near-parallel axonometric to eye-level view at the same door wall.

milestones.label: M09
milestones.observedChange: The same door opens and the camera crosses its opening into the room.

milestones.label: M10
milestones.observedChange: The camera faces the sage kitchen, dining table, tile and pendant inside the assembled room.

milestones.label: M11
milestones.observedChange: The final view reaches the window bench while the kitchen and room surfaces remain continuous.

reverseSemanticStates: Discovery showed return through the same room and hinges; no reverse-only milestone established. Inspect reverse telemetry/video for cleanup asymmetry before verdict.
